products.name: Power Bites
products.description: Soft-baked cacao and peanut bites made for sustained energy between classes.
products.ingredients: Rolled oats, roasted peanuts, dates, cacao powder, chia seeds, and sea salt.
products.process: The ingredients are blended, hand-shaped into bites, then chilled and packed fresh.

products.name: Moringa Oat Crisps
products.description: Toasty whole-grain crisps enriched with locally sourced moringa leaves.
products.ingredients: Whole grain rolled oats, fresh ground moringa (malunggay) leaf powder, white sesame seeds, unrefined coconut oil, and raw cane syrup.
products.process: Flour and fresh moringa purée are folded, rolled thin, and slow-baked to a golden crunch.

products.name: Daily Fuel Bar
products.description: A chewy banana, seed, and oat bar built for busy mornings and active days.
products.ingredients: Sun-ripened bananas, rolled oats, sunflower seeds, pumpkin pepitas, shelled pistachios, and golden flaxseed meal.
products.process: Naturally dried fruits and cold-pressed seeds are pressed into bars and individually foil-sealed.

products.name: Harvest Trail Mix
products.description: A satisfying blend of roasted nuts, pumpkin seeds, cacao nibs, and dried fruit.
products.ingredients: Dry-roasted whole almonds, California walnuts, wild mountain dried cranberries, raw pumpkin seeds, and unsweetened coconut shavings.
products.process: Raw nuts and seeds are dry-roasted at low heat, tossed with single-origin nibs, and sealed.

products.name: Coconut Oat Cookies
products.description: Crisp, lightly sweet cookies baked with rolled oats and real coconut flakes.
products.ingredients: Stone-ground oat flour, jumbo rolled oats, organic coconut oil, fair-trade 70% dark chocolate chips, and coconut sugar.
products.process: Slow-baked in small batches to preserve natural aromatics and texture.

products.name: Nut & Seed Crunch
products.description: Slow-roasted almonds, cashews, and seeds seasoned with a touch of sea salt.
products.ingredients: Crispy roasted pecans, black chia seeds, shelled sunflower kernels, sprouted pumpkin seeds, and hand-harvested pink sea salt.
products.process: Artisan-clustered in small batches, gently salted, and packed into reusable jars.

products.name: Banana Boost Bites
products.description: Chewy banana and flaxseed energy bites rolled in roasted sesame seeds.
products.ingredients: Naturally dehydrated organic bananas, sprouted brown flaxseed, puffed brown rice, ground cashew butter, and toasted white sesame seeds.
products.process: Cold-pressed without baking to retain raw enzymes, natural potassium, and minerals.

products.name: Cacao Bean Clusters
products.description: Rich Philippine single-origin cacao nibs folded into crunchy crisped grains.
products.ingredients: Single-origin Davao cacao nibs, puffed royal quinoa, brown rice crisps, toasted whole hazelnuts, coconut blossom nectar, and sea salt crystals.
products.process: Folded with molten single-origin dark cacao and quick-chilled for signature crunch.

steps.title: Sourcing
steps.description: We select honest, local ingredients from trusted growers.

steps.title: Mixing
steps.description: Every batch is measured and mixed for balanced nutrition.

steps.title: Baking
steps.description: Slow-baked in small batches to keep flavor and goodness in.

steps.title: Packaging
steps.description: Sealed fresh and labeled by hand, ready for your shelves.
